entities.summary: Maxim Sergeyevich Malyutin is a Belarusian professional ice hockey goaltender. He currently plays for Yunost Minsk of the Belarusian Extraliga. Malyutin was selected for the Belarus national men's ice hockey team in the 2010 Winter Olympics.
